newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: At least five killed in Colombian storm.
newsitem.headline: At least five killed in Colombian storm.

text.p: At least five people were killed and an oil storage tank was set ablaze in heavy rains and an electrical storm that swept across northwest Colombia overnight, authorities said on Thursday.
Three adults and two children drowned when floodwaters swept away their makeshift home in a slum on the outskirts of the northwest city of Medellin, police said.
The state oil company, Ecopetrol, said a 16,000-barrel oil storage tank was hit by lightning in Puerto Boyaca, in the northwestern region of Colombia known as the Magdalena Medio.
Ecopetrol said no deaths or injuries were caused in the resulting blaze, which was brought under control early Thursday.
